name: stelaspace-mcp
description: Publish AI-generated HTML (dashboards, reports, docs) to permanent, sandboxed, shareable links.
long_description: StelaSpace is an HTML-first knowledge base for the artifacts AI agents create. This MCP server publishes HTML files straight from your editor — it takes a file path and uploads from disk, so even large data-heavy reports work (file contents can't pass as tool arguments). Each artifact gets a permanent, sandboxed, access-controlled link your team can share. Free tier available.

api_key.title: StelaSpace API key
api_key.description: Starts with ss_sk_ — create one at stelaspace.com under Settings → API Keys

tools.name: publish_file
tools.description: Publish an HTML file from disk to StelaSpace; returns the permanent URL. Reusing a slug publishes a new version.

tools.name: list_spaces
tools.description: List the spaces in your team.

tools.name: list_documents
tools.description: List documents in a space, with optional search.
